item.text: {"rule":"In most rounds, the first two tapped cards were discarded, then one of the two remaining cards was discarded, leaving the other as the chosen card. The observations are insufficient to establish a consistent rule: some rounds described the first pair as remaining, and every final card was the ace of spades."}
